newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan CPC finds natural gas reserve.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan CPC finds natural gas reserve.

text.p: Taiwan state-run Chinese Petroleum Corp said on Monday it had found 1.3 billion cubic metres of under-sea natural gas reserve off the southern city of Kaohsiung.
A company statement said the reserve would provide a daily production of 650,000 cubic metres of natural gas.
The reserve brought the total natural gas reserves in the area to 9.6 billion cubic metres, the statement said.
The statement said the latest reserve is about 100 kilometres (60 miles) west of Kaohsiung.

Chinese Petroleum evacuated workers and halted exploration in the area in March at the time when communist China mounted a series of missile tests near the region during the island's first direct presidential election on March 23.

China, which has viewed the island as a renegade province since a civil war separated them in 1949, acknowledged the war games were aimed to warn Taiwan voters not to drop a pledge to reunify with the mainland.
